name: Dual Mesh Benchmark
description: Preregistered dual-mesh benchmark paper reporting three measurements of the Squirrel OS deterministic anomaly-to-playbook resolution layer: B1 lookup latency — in-process mesh resolver 200/200 correct, median 0.000443 ms, versus an LLM baseline (Automatic engine, fresh platform conversation per instance, wall-clock request-to-validated-tuple) 20/20 valid, 0 failures, median 4509.1 ms; measured ratio median/median 1.018e+07. B2 mesh capacity & collision integrity — 50 synthetic nodes ingested, collision hashes 50/50 unique, state integrity clean. B3 resolution correctness — 72/72 exact replay of the CCR-1 permitted healing-action journal, 0 false positives on negative probes. Binding disclosure: the B1 ratio characterizes the tested environment — deterministic in-process exact-match lookup versus this platform's API conversation loop (agent loop, inference, transport included). It is not a universal performance claim and neither confirms nor supersedes the historical production observation of 267x / 800ms->3ms (September 2026), which remains a historical observation of a different environment. Not model certification; not a production claim. Preregistration discipline: protocol and seeded corpus builder committed to the public append-only ledger before any measurement (corpus sha256 13295d19..., commit 2eb3879); metrics and falsifiers fixed at prereg; identical frozen corpus on both B1 legs; all 220 runs recorded, none removed; falsifiers FB-1..FB-5 all PASS.
